english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for continuing to have or keep something; also use it when a barrier or structure keeps liquid from escaping.
Use this colloquial choice when keeping means continuing to have or retain an object.

examples.english: I want to retain this memory.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 lau4 zyu6 ni1 fan6 wui4 jik1

examples.english: I want to keep this book.
